tools.name: binary_cube_describe_survivability_scoring
tools.description: Describe five-strategy survivability scoring including representation cost and recovered-damage amplification.

tools.name: binary_cube_score_strengthening_survivability
tools.description: Run the authoritative seven-family structural-failure campaign and return explicit survivability, recovered-damage amplification, and damage/cost-adjusted scores for baseline, subcube, chaining, and both compositions.

outputs.recoveredDamageAmplification: total recovered plaintext bit differences divided by total injected encoded-representation bit flips across returned decode cases
outputs.damageAdjustedCostScore: survivabilityScore divided by meanExpansionRatio and by (1 + recoveredDamageAmplification)

claimBoundary: Scores are transparent engineering heuristics over experimental evidence, not cryptographic security ratings or promotion proof.
